by
  constructor
  apply (mul_le_of_forall_lt_of_nonneg ℝ (0 ≤ a) (0 ≤ b) (0 ≤ c))
  intro a' ha'
  intro b' hb'
  intro h1 : a' < a
  intro h2 : b' < b
  have h3 : a' * b' ≤ c :=
    by
      have h4 : a' * b' ≤ a * b :=
        by
          apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left
          exact (0 < a).trans (0 < b)
          exact h1
      have h5 : a * b ≤ c :=
        by
          apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left
          exact (0 < a).trans (0 < b)
          exact h2
      exact h4.trans h5
  exact (0 ≤ a).trans (0 ≤ b).trans (0 ≤ c)
